answer.headline: Conversion rate dropped beyond normal variation due to a product-view drop on the Home landing page.
explanation: Conversion rate fell significantly beyond typical weekly variation.
The Home landing page experienced a sharp decline in its product-view rate starting on Thursday, December 31, 2020.
This specific drop accounts for a major share of the overall conversion decline on the site.
